```{r}
#load data and package
library(tidyverse)
library(tidytext)
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)
library(tidytext)
artist <- read.csv("artistDf.csv")
songs <- read.csv("billboardHot100_1999-2019.csv")
```

```{r}
#data-preprocessing and clean
artist_clean <- artist %>%
  distinct(Artist, .keep_all = TRUE)

pre_data <- songs %>%
  inner_join(artist_clean, by = c("Artists" = "Artist"))

final_data <- pre_data %>%
  filter(Group.Solo == "Solo") %>%
  mutate(Gender = toupper(trimws(Gender))) %>%
  filter(Gender %in% c("M", "F")) %>%
  distinct(Name, Artists, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\[.*?\\]", ""), 
         Lyrics = str_replace_all(Lyrics, "\\n", " "),
         Lyrics = str_squish(Lyrics)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Lyrics), nchar(Lyrics) > 50)

```



```{r}
#basic analysis for sample size's percentage
gender_counts <- final_data %>%
  count(Gender) %>%
  mutate(prop = n / sum(n),
         label = paste0(n, " (", percent(prop, accuracy = 0.1), ")"))

ggplot(gender_counts, aes(x = Gender, y = n, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.6, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.5, size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Songs by Artist Gender",
       subtitle = paste("Total sample size: ", nrow(final_data)),
       x = "Gender",
       y = "Number of Songs") +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15)))
```

```{r}
#analysis for lyrics' tfidf
gender_words <- final_data %>%
  unnest_tokens(word, Lyrics) %>%
  anti_join(stop_words) %>% 
  count(Gender, word, sort = TRUE)

# Calculate tf-idf
gender_tfidf <- gender_words %>%
  bind_tf_idf(word, Gender, n) %>%
  arrange(desc(tf_idf))

female_top <- gender_tfidf %>%
  filter(Gender == "F") %>%
  slice_max(tf_idf, n = 15)

male_top <- gender_tfidf %>%
  filter(Gender == "M") %>%
  slice_max(tf_idf, n = 15)

print(female_top)
print(male_top)

plot_tfidf <- bind_rows(female_top, male_top)
ggplot(plot_tfidf, aes(reorder_within(word, tf_idf, Gender), tf_idf, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~Gender, scales = "free") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(title = "Highest TF-IDF Words by Gender",
       x = NULL, y = "TF-IDF Score") 
```



```{r}
#analysis for lyrics length
final_data <- final_data %>%
  mutate(word_count = str_count(Lyrics, "\\w+"))

ggplot(final_data, aes(x = Gender, y = word_count, fill = Gender)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_y_log10() + 
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Lyric Length Distribution by Gender", y = "Word Count (Log Scale)")
```
